learning_outcomes.text: Continual improvement of all language skills focused on communication/speaking, listening comprehension and writing.
Emphasis on discourse, lexicology and morphology.
Word-bank broadening of communicational/spoken English as well as English for specific purpose appropriate for university students.

syllabus_topics: Broadening spoken/communicational English for students with B2/C1 level of English knowledge (Upper-Intermediate/Lower Advanced)
bibliography: Appropriate study material is supplied based on the participants’ level of English by the lecturer. (Sources- The Guardian, The Herald Morning Sun. The Nine News, The West Australian, BBC News and podcasts, CNN podcasts).
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
